title: The parity stage times out at its calibration-ready barrier on macOS before any parity assertion runs
outcome: The parity stage times out at its calibration-ready barrier on macOS before any parity assertion runs
acceptance: The cause of the calibration-ready barrier timeout in scripts/parity.test.mjs on the Mac is identified and stated here, from the retained log of run test-efe66332
A standard full gate on the Mac passes the parity stage on a master containing the fix, without loosening any parity assertion or timeout budget merely to pass
The parity stage still passes on Windows
